title.narrative: Supporting Government of Pakistan in the Protection and Promotion of Tangible Heritage

description.narrative: Within the framework of the Strategic Cooperation Roadmap (2026-30) finalized in follow up to the high level meeting of Director General UNESCO with Prime-Minister of Pakistan in February 2026, the proposed intervention aims to build upon the earlier activities and enhance the institutional capacity of Pakistan in effective implementation of the World Heritage Convention through supporting the Federal and Provincial Directorates of Archaeology and Museums in following international standards for conservation and management, updating the Tentative List, developing management plans and overall implementation of the recommendations finalized during the consultation meeting organized during the last biennium and training workshop on World Heritage Management organized in January 2026.
